capabilities.title: Real-time global OSINT dashboard with multi-source intelligence panels
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Repository description: Open Source Global Intelligence Platform / Real-Time OSINT Dashboard
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Nexus preserves the multi-domain situational-awareness pattern across governed INTEL, RECON, and COMMAND surfaces instead of copying one unrestricted scanner dashboard. The INTEL fusion strip links significant events to regions and reviewed operational follow-up.

capabilities.title: Map-centric fusion of events, entities, and live feeds
capabilities.sourceEvidence: OSINT dashboard products typically ship geospatial event layers (homepage osirisai.live)
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Nexus-native geo-fused event strip on INTEL links conflict feed critical/high events to their region and includes an OPS map deep-link. No Osiris code vendored; pattern adapted as a minimal fused strip.

capabilities.title: Analyst workbench for linking entities, timelines, and investigations
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Positioned as a Palantir alternative in repository metadata
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The passive-first RECON casefile links subjects, goals, evidence, pivots, gaps, reviewed next moves, and prior case continuity into a durable VAULT record. Nexus does not claim Palantir graph parity; it adapts the investigation workbench pattern with visible evidence and human review.

capabilities.title: Embed or vendor the Osiris application inside Nexus
capabilities.reason: Nexus stays one MIT app; Osiris remains a complementary reference, not a merged codebase.

capabilities.title: Cryptocurrency promotion strings in upstream metadata
capabilities.sourceEvidence: GitHub API description includes pump.fun referral text
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not promote trading tokens or referral rails; ignore upstream promo metadata.
